Fact: compute_methodology
What to find: Methodology used to measure or estimate training computation.
Card sections that often contain it: Compute, FLOPs

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Training compute is reported as GPU hours: cumulative 7.38M GPU hours for pre-training on H100-80GB (TDP 700W) hardware, where training time is the total GPU time required for training each model. No FLOPs-based methodology is given.
quotes: Training Energy Use: Model pre-training utilized a cumulative of 7.38M GPU hours of computation on H100-80GB (TDP of 700W) type hardware, per the table below.
Training time is the total GPU time required for training each model and power consumption is the peak power capacity per GPU device used, adjusted for power usage efficiency.
